description: A monotone function sends each upper bound of S to an upper bound of the image of S.
signature:
Monotone.image_upperBounds_subset_upperBounds_image.{u, v} {α : Type u} {β : Type v} [Preorder α] [Preorder β]
  {f : α → β} (Hf : Monotone f) {s : Set α} : f '' upperBounds s ⊆ upperBounds (f '' s)
